case.summary: Verdict: uncertain — the evidence does not support a confirmed fraud pattern. Card C04570-K1 (customer C04570) made three online purchases on 2016-11-11 (txns 3450436, 3450503, 3450629, totaling $300.14 in exposure) for ~$100 each, but these amounts and the online channel fit the customer's history (mean $246.40, prior online purchases of product R), and the heuristic hint flags this as a single-signal case with fraud probability 0.28 and no matching known pattern. The shared email (anonymous.com) and region (204) clusters are large but not flagged as shared signals, and similar case CC-1383 was cleared after customer verification. Recommended action: VERIFY_WITH_CUSTOMER (or STEP_UP_AUTH) per R1 before any block, with MONITOR_CARD as a follow-up; escalate to an analyst only if the customer cannot confirm the transactions.
